title: Osteoporosis screening: postmenopausal women younger than 65 years at increased fracture risk

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends screening for osteoporosis to prevent osteoporotic fractures in postmenopausal women younger than 65 years who are at increased risk for an osteoporotic fracture as estimated by clinical risk assessment.

action: Screen for osteoporosis to prevent osteoporotic fractures

derived.max: 'younger than 65 years' in whole years means age 64 or less at end of measurement year

uncomputable.needs: clinical risk assessment showing increased osteoporotic fracture risk (clinician judgment / risk tool)

all.quote: at increased risk for an osteoporotic fracture as estimated by clinical risk assessment

uncomputable.needs: osteoporosis screening test type and screening interval, neither stated in this section (deferred to Practice Considerations)

numerator.note: Likely dxa_scan, but test modality and look-back window are not specified in the section text, so not encoded as computable
